description: Source-abstraction layer (build-order step 2). Normalize the two data origins -- CBOE-live (via the existing distilled snapshot format) and the Kaggle historical QQQ CSV -- into ONE internal chain schema keyed on (root,expiry,type,strike), carrying greeks/IV/volume and OI-where-available, with per-source provenance and quality flags. This is what makes the true-GEX vs OI-proxy distinction explicit downstream: CBOE carries OI (true GEX); the Kaggle CSV has NO open-interest column, so it must carry a volume-proxy flag and never be presented as classic OI-GEX. Independent of FEAT-003+; it defines the data contract every later engine consumes.
steps: Create src/gammamap/chain.py defining an internal normalized model: a NormalizedContract dataclass (root, expiry as a real date + original yymmdd, right/type C|P, strike, open_interest Optional[int], gamma Optional[float], delta, iv, bid, ask, volume, plus flags) and a NormalizedChain dataclass (symbol, asof timestamp, spot_from_feed, per-expiry contracts, source provenance dict, quality_flags list, and an oi_available bool). Keep the (root,expiry,type,strike) tuple as the identity key exactly as distill.py already does (C7).

Create src/gammamap/adapters.py with two adapters producing NormalizedChain: (1) from_distilled_snapshot(snap_dir, symbol) -- read the committed greeks_*.csv.gz + the referenced oi/*.csv.gz from meta.json, join on the full key, set oi_available=True, provenance source='cboe_delayed', carry the meta.json quality_flags. Reuse distill.parse_osi / column names; do not re-fetch. (2) from_kaggle_csv_row_group(...) -- parse the Kaggle qqq_2020_2022.csv schema. IMPORTANT verified schema quirk: column headers are BRACKETED and space-padded, e.g. '[QUOTE_DATE]', ' [C_GAMMA]', ' [STRIKE]', ' [P_IV]', ' [C_VOLUME]'; strip brackets+whitespace when parsing the header. Columns present: QUOTE_UNIXTIME, QUOTE_READTIME, QUOTE_DATE, QUOTE_TIME_HOURS, UNDERLYING_LAST, EXPIRE_DATE, DTE, C_DELTA C_GAMMA C_VEGA C_THETA C_RHO C_IV C_VOLUME C_BID C_ASK, STRIKE, P_BID P_ASK P_DELTA P_GAMMA P_VEGA P_THETA P_RHO P_IV P_VOLUME, STRIKE_DISTANCE(_PCT). There is NO open-interest column: set open_interest=None, oi_available=False, and add quality flag 'oi_absent_volume_proxy'. Root for QQQ rows is 'QQQ'; expiry from EXPIRE_DATE; one row yields BOTH a call and a put NormalizedContract (split C_* and P_* fields).

Provenance + flags: every NormalizedChain records source id, retrieval/quote timestamps, and propagates distill quality flags. Add a helper is_true_gex(chain) -> bool that is True only when oi_available is True; otherwise downstream must label output as a volume-weighted proxy.

Add tests/test_source_abstraction.py: (a) from_distilled_snapshot on the committed 2026-09-06/230612Z QQQ snapshot yields a NormalizedChain with oi_available=True, contract count matching meta.json distilled rows_kept (7943 for QQQ), and both NDX+NDXP roots when loading _NDX; (b) a small inline Kaggle-CSV fixture (a few hand-written rows using the exact bracketed header) parses into call+put contracts with oi_available=False and the 'oi_absent_volume_proxy' flag present; (c) the identity key is (root,expiry,type,strike) and duplicate keys are rejected/flagged.
Commit on nuke_root: 'feat: source-abstraction layer normalizing CBOE-live and Kaggle-CSV into one chain schema'.
acceptance_criteria: from_distilled_snapshot loads the committed QQQ snapshot into a NormalizedChain with oi_available=True and 7943 contracts (matching meta.json).
from_distilled_snapshot on _NDX carries both NDX and NDXP roots and keys on the full (root,expiry,type,strike) tuple.

The Kaggle adapter parses the exact bracketed/space-padded header, splits each row into a call and a put contract, sets open_interest=None/oi_available=False, and emits the 'oi_absent_volume_proxy' flag.
is_true_gex returns True for the CBOE chain and False for the Kaggle chain.
All tests pass under PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/ -q.
verification: export PYENV_ROOT="/root/.pyenv" && export PATH="$PYENV_ROOT/shims:$PYENV_ROOT/bin:$PATH" && pyenv global 3.11.15 && PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/test_source_abstraction.py -q
